about: BOXVR brings music enhanced, boxing inspired workouts to Virtual Reality.

Leading fitness instructors help us produce a variety of boxing workouts, specifically designed to destroy calories in the most entertaining way ever devised! From short 3 minute warm ups to 60+ minute endurance workouts, we’ve got everything you need to give you a fantastic cardio workout!
Every workout is recorded so you can see how many calories you've burned. Set your own goals and see your progress day by day to stay motivated.
From Rock to Pop, Dance to Hip Hop, we’ve got the music that will get you boxing to your favourite beat!
With over 100 different music tracks you can create your own workouts with varying levels of intensity. Build and save as many custom routines as you like.
We are constantly improving BOXVR with new Classes, Music, Moves and Features. Our goal is to change lives for the better.
summary: BOXVR brings music enhanced, boxing inspired workouts to Virtual Reality.
